convert_bart_checkpoint: convert a fairseq BART checkpoint to a HuggingFace PyTorch model and save to a directory
load_xsum_checkpoint: load a fairseq BART-XSUM checkpoint from a model.pt file and return a hub interface
convert_bart_cli: run the CLI to convert a fairseq BART checkpoint to HuggingFace format with argparse
rename_state_dict_keys: rename and filter keys in a fairseq BART state dict for HuggingFace compatibility
make_linear_from_emb: build a linear layer from an embedding weight matrix for the LM head conversion
